# thalassa_vpc_private_connector (Data Source)

Get a VPC private connector by identity



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `id` (String) Identity of the VPC private connector

### Optional

- `organisation_id` (String) Reference to the Organisation of the VPC private connector. If not provided, the organisation of the (Terraform) provider will be used.

### Read-Only

- `annotations` (Map of String) Annotations for the VPC private connector
- `attached_security_groups` (List of String) List of security group identities attached to the VPC private connector
- `endpoint_ipv4` (String) IPv4 endpoint address of the VPC private connector
- `endpoint_ipv6` (String) IPv6 endpoint address of the VPC private connector
- `labels` (Map of String) Labels for the VPC private connector
- `status` (String) Status of the VPC private connector
- `status_message` (String) Additional information about the current status
- `type` (String) Type of the VPC private connector
- `vpc_id` (String) Identity of the VPC that the private connector belongs to
